text: The hospital cannot use equipment that is still waiting for procurement review. Across Africa, public procurement averages 17% of GDP according to the World Bank. In Zambia, Quorum starts with the officers' desk, read the evidence, identify the gaps, and prepare a decision that people can explain. Here is the actual supplier workflow. Required documents stay together in one checklist. The supplier opens a supporting file and requests an AI document check. The findings appear beside the source so the reviewer can compare them. This helps prepare the submission. It does not decide whether the supplier qualifies. Now the recorded officer workspace. The team moves from the tender notice through opening an evaluation, published criteria, governed the review officers can inspect the matrix, compare the admitted bits and trace the supporting file. These earlier recordings use illustrative records, their fields vary, the committee enters its own scores, Quorum keeps the review and the accountable decision connected. The officer opens the AI-assisted bid review, confirms permission to share the documents and starts the assessment. Every admitted bidder is considered against the same issue criteria. Watch what happens when the submitted information does not establish a requirement, the result says not evidenced the AI leaves the gap visible and gives the committee questions to resolve. It can offer an advisory comparison, but it cannot turn missing evidence into a pass. Muse Spark on Meta Model API also returned a separately verified source linked assessment included with the submission. The original recording also shows the people who make the decision. Here is the committee panel followed by member registration. Each officer has an identity, role and recorded position, evaluator sheets, score differences and committee consensus remain part of the file. The AI's recommendation is advised for consideration official scores, formal ranking and the award remain with authorized people. Quorum keeps that distinction visible. We also tested the approval boundary against the production build. An unsigned request returns for a one assigned in request without step-up verification returns for a three. The gate remains pending with no receipt. A separate authorized fictional account then completes two factor verification and the local simulation produces a signature verified receipt. This is test evidence not a government portal transaction. Quorum. Built by Chungu Chama. The agent prepares the file. The authorized committee makes the decision.
